newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 27.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- The Funeral Committee for Deng Xiaoping issues its third announcement, expressing gratitude to officials and diplomats who sent condolences over Deng's death.

- Delegates to the National People's Congress and members of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference honour the memory of Deng Xiaoping and pledge to do a good job in state affairs.
- A front page editorial hails the opening of the fifth session of the National Committee of the Eighth Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Beijing this afternoon.
- The political department of the People's Liberation Army releases a circular calling for all troops and armed police to study President Jiang Zemin's memorial speech for Deng Xiaoping.
- China will start the issue of one billion yuan of corporate bonds for the Three Gorges dam project on Friday.
- China says it will keep gold output over 100 tonnes this year, investing 1.6 billion yuan in fixed assets.
- The Ministry of Public Security orders tighter supervision of explosives, saying illegal explosives were flooding the country and being used for criminal activity.
